title: request.rs uses inline std::collections::HashSet and crate::error::ClientError paths — missing use imports
description: request.rs imports HashMap via 'use std::collections::HashMap' at the top, but uses std::collections::HashSet and crate::error::ClientError inline throughout the file. Clippy will flag these: 'use of full path when a use import would suffice'. Fix: add 'use std::collections::HashSet;' and 'use crate::error::ClientError;' to the use block at the top of request.rs. This is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase (other modules import their deps at the top).
